product.title: Ultimate Monterey Bay Cannery Row GoCar Tour

description.text: Explore Monterey, Cannery Row, and Pacific Grove at your own pace in a GPS-guided GoCar. The narrated route covers waterfront landmarks, 17-Mile Drive access points, and scenic overlooks with flexible one- to three-hour rental windows.

highlights: GPS-guided GoCar tour of Monterey and Cannery Row
Flexible one- to three-hour rental duration
Narrated route through Pacific Grove and bay viewpoints
Self-drive format with live GPS commentary
Cover more ground than a standard walking tour

start.description: Pick up the GoCar at the Monterey operator location listed in your booking confirmation.

end.description: Return the GoCar to the original Monterey pickup location.

product.itinerarySummary: Explore Monterey, Cannery Row, and Pacific Grove at your own pace in a GPS-guided GoCar.

itineraryItems.title: Cannery Row
itineraryItems.description: Drive the narrated Cannery Row segment with GPS commentary at each landmark.

itineraryItems.title: Monterey Bay
itineraryItems.description: Follow waterfront routes with stops at bay overlooks when you choose to pause.

itineraryItems.title: Pacific Grove
itineraryItems.description: Continue into Pacific Grove coastal lanes on the GPS-guided route.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Ultimate Monterey Bay Cannery Row GoCar Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 1 to 3 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Monterey?
faqs.answer: Pick up the GoCar at the Monterey operator location listed in your booking confirmation.
